decisions.decision: Raw learned categorical bytes and own EOS; no attention, Transformer or arithmetic features

decisions.decision: V3 is not an equivalent controlled upgrade of Full151 or ANSWER-0

decisions.decision: Faithful ANSWER-0 reference on the unchanged current task
decisions.basis: Existing compatible end-to-end source reached taught acquisition after repetition

decisions.decision: Old expressive ELM cell as candidate basis
decisions.basis: Recovered actual private-state, internal-MLP, sparse-message implementation
decisions.limits: Single-seed image evidence has unequal parameters and 150000 presentations; no arithmetic evidence

decisions.decision: Learned byte embedding replaces image sensory input

decisions.limits: At least 24 candidate latent input channels or an explicit source graph change; final width not claimed optimal
decisions.consequence: No operand roles, ASCII numerical order or fixed semantic representation

decisions.decision: Advance the inherited generic cell per actual byte and own generation event
decisions.basis: Image episode is incompatible with the byte stream
decisions.limits: Maintain generic state through a reply; reset boundaries common; generated outputs are not teaching truth
decisions.consequence: No special action based on operators

decisions.decision: 257-class learned affine output and own EOS
decisions.basis: Existing image classifier has ten classes; arbitrary byte output required
decisions.limits: Additional head parameters and all output computation counted
decisions.consequence: No masks, numeric renderer or lookup answer table

decisions.decision: Remove visual pixel geometry; document any generic sparse graph substitution
decisions.basis: Pixel geometry is not a general byte input structure
decisions.limits: This is a real topology change, not byte-for-byte old topology inheritance
decisions.consequence: No learned rewiring or extra loops bundled by default

decisions.basis: Prior RAW-RULE boundary geometry and current first/suffix content failures
decisions.limits: V3 final weights unavailable; its geometry not measured. Additional snapshot/decoder is a separate mechanism
decisions.consequence: Matched control and paid state/compute if added

decisions.decision: No default fast/slow synapse addition or content-weighted KV route
decisions.basis: M022/M035/M041 warn against moving coordinates and coupled/combined storage; attention excluded
decisions.limits: Working state and lasting synaptic storage are different; ordinary local plasticity is not all banned
decisions.consequence: Any permitted synaptic trace must be declared and isolated

decisions.decision: Do not promote R8/RU8/C/P from current short preparation
decisions.basis: Constant 1 or immediate EOS outputs; no short-budget benefit from eight rescans
decisions.limits: One short world, unmatched optimizer cadence for P vs G0; candidates lack full-dose results

decisions.decision: Count repeat presentations, replay, actual updates and whole compute
decisions.basis: Old ANSWER-0 has much more repetition; P/G4 80 updates vs G0 320
decisions.limits: More repeats may restore taught recall but did not establish old unseen products

decisions.decision: Keep all complete overlapping inventory versions
